explanation: Mathlib states that for symmetric A, B the family (i : 𝕜 × 𝕜) ↦ eigenspace A i.2 ⊓ eigenspace B i.1 is an OrthogonalFamily with the subtypeₗᵢ embeddings. The target is the same family, but indexed by pairs of eigenvalues, which are subtypes of 𝕜 (here 𝕜 = ℂ) via Eigenvalues.val. JointEigenSpace unfolds to the same inf. The target follows by reindexing along the injective map c ↦ (c.1.val, c.2.val) with OrthogonalFamily.comp (Subtype.ext and Prod.ext give injectivity). The current proof does the same thing by hand with hf.ne. I did not read the Eigenvalues index order in the Mathlib source, so the swapped order of the pair in the derivation is taken from the target's own proof.
